errors.text_span: Някои сектори — особено „рецесия“ — са визуално изместени навън от основния кръг, за да бъдат по-добре различими.
errors.evidence: The description claims that some sectors, particularly 'recession', are visually shifted outwards (exploded). In the actual image, no sectors are exploded or offset from the main circle; it is a standard pie chart.

errors.text_span: а останалите са разположени по часовниковата стрелка
errors.evidence: The description states that the sectors are arranged clockwise from the largest one. However, to achieve the descending order mentioned, one must move counter-clockwise from the largest (grey) sector to the yellow (13%), then blue (5%), and orange (5%) sectors.
